escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution via @grpc/grpc-js (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker-controlled .proto files execute arbitrary JavaScript during deserialization in the orchestrator process — full pipeline compromise.

backlog.title: Source/ system has no canonical Specification — entirely plan-traced only
backlog.detail: Source/ implements FR-WF-001..FR-WF-013 from Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md only. Specifications/ never covers the Source/ system. CLAUDE.md states Specifications are the source of truth.
backlog.recommendation: Promote Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md to Specifications/workflow-engine-spec.md, or update the traceability enforcer to validate Specifications/ as well.

backlog.title: Route handlers bypass service layer — direct store calls in 3 route files
backlog.detail: workItems.ts:12,44,73,79,89,134,142; workflow.ts:15,44,71,99,119,155,175,217,269,317,359; intake.ts:4,19,42 all import and call workItemStore directly. CLAUDE.md: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.'
backlog.recommendation: Create workItemsService.ts wrapping all store operations; refactor the 3 route files to be thin HTTP adapters.

backlog.title: portal/Backend teamDispatches.ts — unspecified feature, zero traceability
backlog.detail: 85 lines, recently modified. Zero Verifies comments. teamDispatch/TeamsPage feature not in Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md. Unlinked scope creep.
backlog.recommendation: Add team-dispatch as a formal FR in the canonical spec and back-link with Verifies comments, or document scope decision in a Plan.

backlog.title: Duplicate frontend test files — root-level and tests/pages/ copies coexist
backlog.detail: Root-level copies are legacy duplicates of tests/pages/ equivalents. Both run, creating false coverage confidence and possible double-execution.
backlog.recommendation: Delete Source/Frontend/tests/WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx and WorkItemListPage.test.tsx (root-level). Keep tests/pages/ versions.

backlog.title: Path-to-Regexp ReDoS — orchestrator DoS via crafted URL (CVSS 7.5)
backlog.detail: path-to-regexp <0.1.13 via express. Specially crafted URL path causes exponential regex backtracking → orchestrator DoS, build pipeline stalls.
backlog.recommendation: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update express (pulls path-to-regexp ≥0.1.13)

backlog.title: @grpc/grpc-js server crash + cert validation bypass (3 CVEs, CVSS 7.5)
backlog.detail: Malformed gRPC request → immediate server crash. getAuthContext bypass → unauthorized certs accepted. All fixed in @grpc/grpc-js ≥1.14.5.

backlog.title: Jest 29.x ecosystem: 10+ HIGH CVEs in Backend dev dependencies
backlog.detail: jest@29.7.0 transitive chain: jest-message-util, js-yaml, micromatch all HIGH CVEs. YAML merge-key DoS, regex vulnerabilities. Dev-only but affects CI reliability.
backlog.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update jest  # upgrade to ≥30.5.2

backlog.title: Browserslist unbounded memory growth — frontend build OOM (CVSS 7.5)
backlog.detail: browserslist ≤4.28.6: no cache eviction → eventual OOM on repeated builds; malicious browserslist-stats.json crashes build process.

backlog.title: FR-dependency-seed — specified but never implemented
backlog.detail: Idempotent seed data requirement (BUG-0010 blocked_by BUG-0003..0007; FR-0004 blocked_by FR-0003) has zero Verifies references in portal/ or Source/.
backlog.recommendation: Implement seed migration/script in portal/Backend and add Verifies comment, or mark FR deferred with rationale.

backlog.title: eslint-disable suppressing react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 2 files
backlog.detail: Two eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps comments masking stale closure risks.
backlog.recommendation: Audit both suppressions: add missing dep, refactor with useCallback/useRef, or document why intentional.

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer blind to Specifications/ — CI gate incomplete
backlog.detail: Enforcer auto-discovers most-recent Plan and checks FR IDs against Source/. Never reads Specifications/. A spec requirement could be removed and the gate would still pass.
backlog.recommendation: Add --specs flag to enforcer that cross-references Specifications/ FR IDs against portal/ and Source/.

backlog.title: React Router open redirect — protocol-relative URL exploitation
backlog.detail: @remix-run/router <1.23.3 via react-router-dom. Path starting '//' triggers protocol-relative URL → redirects to attacker site. Credential theft / phishing vector.
backlog.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update react-router-dom  # pulls @remix-run/router ≥1.23.3

backlog.title: @vitest/mocker path traversal — arbitrary file read in dev environment
backlog.detail: Redirect mock in @vitest/mocker ≤4.1.10 allows arbitrary file read via path traversal. Dev/test only but could leak source or env files.

backlog.title: UUID <11.1.1 buffer bounds check missing — orchestrator + frontend
backlog.detail: Missing bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf parameter provided. Low impact in JS context but widely transitive.
backlog.recommendation: npm update uuid  # in both projects; or dockerode upgrade pulls it transitively

backlog.title: QS DoS — 3 CVEs in orchestrator express transitive chain
backlog.detail: qs 2.2.5–6.15.3: crash via null/undefined in comma arrays, array-limit bypass, attacker-controlled isBuffer DoS.
backlog.recommendation: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update express  # pulls qs latest

backlog.title: baseline-browser-mapping DoS — invalid input terminates build process
backlog.detail: baseline-browser-mapping 2.0.0–2.11.0: invalid input causes process termination during frontend build.

backlog.title: @babel/core arbitrary file read — local build environment only
backlog.detail: @babel/core ≤7.29.0: sourceMappingURL comment exploitation allows local attacker to read arbitrary files. Requires local filesystem access.
backlog.recommendation: npm update @babel/core  # ≥7.30.0 in Backend and Frontend

backlog.title: body-parser invalid limit DoS — orchestrator express transitive
backlog.detail: body-parser <1.20.6: invalid limit value silently disables size enforcement → unbounded request parsing. Low impact if config is controlled.
backlog.recommendation: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update express  # pulls body-parser ≥1.20.6

grading_thresholds_used.F: exploitable auth bypass + critical domain failure

metadata.grade_rationale: 2 P1s (at C-threshold max), 7 P2s (within C threshold), spec coverage 76% (exceeds C threshold of 40%). Cannot qualify for B: B requires 0 P1s.
